dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Over there. Men on the left, women on the right.
dialogue.reading: ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr. ˈmɛn ɑːn ðə ˈlɛft, ˈwɪmɪn ɑːn ðə ˈraɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh, what does the door say?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈoʊ, ˈwʌt dʌz ðə ˈdɔːr ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Occupied." Wait a minute… Now it's vacant.
dialogue.reading: "ˈɑːkjəpaɪd." ˈweɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt… ˈnaʊ ɪts ˈveɪkənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Walk slowly, Emma. It says "Wet floor."
dialogue.reading: ˈwɔːk ˈsloʊli, ˈɛmə. ɪt ˈsɛz "ˈwɛt ˈflɔːr."
